goal.vi: Tóm tắt kinh nghiệm, nói về điểm yếu một cách thật lòng, đưa kết quả cụ thể và hỏi về bước tiếp theo.
goal.en: Sum up your experience, talk about a weakness honestly, give real results and ask about next steps.

dialogue.aRole: a hiring manager at a software company
lines: a
Thanks for coming in. Could you start by telling me about your background?
b
Sure. Let me walk you through my background. In my last role, I was responsible for a team of five.
a
And what drew you to this position?
b
What drew me to this role was the chance to lead bigger projects.
a
What would you say is your biggest weakness?
b
One thing I'm working on is delegating more. I used to do everything myself, so now I share tasks earlier.
a
Can you give me an example of a result you're proud of?
b
We changed our testing process. As a result, we cut bugs by 30 percent.
a
Impressive. Do you have any questions for me?
b
Yes. What are the next steps in the process?

phrases.say: Let me walk you through my background.
phrases.not: I will explain you my CV.

mean.vi: Mở đầu phần giới thiệu kinh nghiệm

why.vi: Không nói "explain you"; hãy nói "explain to you" hoặc "walk you through".
why.en: Don't say "explain you"; say "explain to you" or "walk you through".

phrases.say: What drew me to this role was the chance to lead projects.
phrases.not: I apply because I need a job.

mean.vi: Nói điều gì khiến bạn thích vị trí này
mean.en: Say what attracts you to the job

why.vi: Nói điều cuốn hút bạn, không chỉ điều bạn cần.
why.en: Talk about what attracts you, not only what you need.

phrases.say: One thing I'm working on is delegating more.
phrases.not: My weakness is I am too perfectionist.

mean.vi: Nói về điểm yếu một cách thật lòng

why.vi: Nêu một điểm yếu thật và cách bạn đang cải thiện nó.
why.en: Name a real weakness and show how you are improving.

phrases.say: In my last role, I was responsible for a team of five.
phrases.not: In my last job I was responsible of five people.

mean.vi: Nói về trách nhiệm trong công việc trước
mean.en: Talk about your duties in your last job

phrases.say: As a result, we cut costs by 20 percent.
phrases.not: So the result was very good.

mean.vi: Nêu kết quả cụ thể của việc bạn làm
mean.en: Give a clear result of your work

why.vi: Kết quả có con số thuyết phục hơn lời khen chung chung.
why.en: A result with numbers is stronger than "very good".

phrases.say: Could you tell me more about the team I'd be working with?

mean.vi: Hỏi thêm về đội nhóm để thể hiện bạn quan tâm
mean.en: Ask about the team to show real interest

why.vi: Câu hỏi hay cho thấy bạn thật sự quan tâm đến công việc.
why.en: Good questions show you really care about the job.

phrases.say: What are the next steps in the process?

mean.vi: Hỏi về bước tiếp theo sau buổi phỏng vấn
mean.en: Ask what happens after the interview

why.vi: "Next steps" nghe chuyên nghiệp; câu hỏi phải là "when will you".
why.en: "Next steps" sounds professional; in questions, say "when will you".

ai.name: Daniel
ai.role: a hiring manager at a software company
ai.goal: find out the candidate's experience, weakness and results

roleplay.you: Walk the manager through your background, talk about a weakness, give a result with a number and ask about next steps.

turns.a: Thanks for coming in. Could you tell me about your background?
turns.h: Sure. Let me walk you through it. In my last role, I was responsible for a small team.

turns.a: What would you say is your biggest weakness?
turns.h: One thing I'm working on is delegating more. I'm getting better at it.

turns.a: Tell me about a result you're proud of.
turns.h: We changed our process. As a result, we cut costs by 20 percent.

turns.a: Do you have any questions for me?
turns.h: Yes. What are the next steps in the process?

roleplay.end: We'll talk with two more people this week, and you'll hear from us by Friday. Thanks for your time!
